## Highlights
### New
- Choose borderless pages and a right-side sidebar on iPhone and iPad, with a live Settings preview and swipe-in access from the chosen edge - Look and Feel settings show one live preview of your sidebar and page beside compact, aligned controls, and every changed setting can be reset on its own - Tune tab corner shape, tab scale, pin layout, color borders, fills, hover tint, and the address field's colors, with presets for the common choices - Choose a color palette for Crest's app icon on Mac, iPhone, and iPad - Design Space crests with more heraldic artwork, shapes, patterns, independent colors, emoji, monograms, and a searchable SF Symbols picker
### Improved
- Default page zoom moved into Look and Feel and shows in the live preview - Folder color intensity and text color moved into each Space's appearance editor - Open Settings in a browser tab on Mac and iPad, with more room for controls and live sidebar customization - Keep crest previews visible while editing, with faster updates and color choices beside each part of the design - Use clearer route cards, full-width settings lists, matching icon pickers, and labeled data-retention choices
---
Development builds contain the newest changes and may be less reliable than stable releases.
